sources.title: A dynamic model to predict early occurrence of acute kidney injury in ICU hospitalized cirrhotic patients: a MIMIC database analysis

evidence.text: MAP, WBC, TB, GCS, Cr, Alb, HR and PLT were included in this nomogram, making it an objective and simple-to-use tool to screen patients for AKI in a dynamic online manner.
However, there is no relevant research or clinical prediction model for the risk assessment of AKI within 7 days after admission in ICU patients with liver cirrhosis.

sources.title: Machine learning model for predicting the risk of AKI in early hemodynamically stable sepsis patients: a study based on the MIMIC IV database

evidence.text: This study analyzed data collected from the MIMIC IV database.
Among the externally validated models, the AUC for XGBoost was the highest at 0.838, RF was 0.799, making it the second highest after XGBoost.
A total of 370 sepsis patients were included in the external validation, Among them, 61 patients developed AKI.
